content.title: XO, Kitty Season 3 Cameos, Release Date, Photos, and Everything You Need to Know
content.text: YOUNGSOL PARK/NETFLIXAs soon as we finished season 1 of XO, Kitty, you better believe we began eagerly anticipating season 2, and, of course, the wait was back on for XO, Kitty season 3—at least it was, until now, because we finally have a release date!After an almost two-year break, XO, Kitty season 2 finally premiered on Netflix on January 16, 2025, and immediately snagged the first position on Netflix's most-watched shows list during its debut weekend. Given its instant popularity and season 2's open ending, watchers will be happy to know that XO, Kitty season 3 is headed our way very soon, and Lana Condor will be back as Lara Jean!Since it was first announced, XO, Kitty has almost become synonymous with waits. It took two whole years since the show's initial announcement as a long-anticipated To All The Boys spinoff series for season 1 to hit Netflix, and then we got another two-year wait in between seasons.Anna Cathcart Steps Into Her Own Spotlight in *XO, Kitty*“I kind of grew up with Kitty by my side,” Cathcart says.ICYMI: XO, Kitty follows the silver-tongued Katherine Song Covey, a.k.a. Kitty, a fan-favorite from the TATB movies, after she gets the same scholarship her late mom received in her teenage years and enrolls in an international high school in South Korea. "Grab your helmets, kids, this is gonna be a wild ride," leading lady Anna Cathcart wrote on Instagram when the series was first announced—and she was more than right.Season 1 followed Kitty as she made her way to Seoul to reunite with her long-distance boyfriend Dae (played by Choi Minyeong), and what followed was indeed a rollercoaster, with all its ups and downs, romantic spins, and breakups. In season 2, we see Kitty returning to Seoul (in case you need a refresher, she was expelled but was granted a second chance), and the love triangles begin again. Our girl doesn't necessarily thrive academically, since she's too busy navigating her newfound bisexuality and grappling with her feelings towards Praveena, Yuri, Min Ho, and, well, everyone.Much like season 1, season 2 of XO, Kitty ended on another very familiar cliffhanger, so it's only natural to wonder what Kitty's future holds. Now that XO, Kitty season 3 is around the corner, what can we expect from it? Well, here's everything we know so far.Jump to your preferred section:When is XO, Kitty season 3 coming out?Park Young-Sol/NetflixXO, Kitty season 3 will officially premiere on Netflix globally on April 2, 2026.↑BACK TO TOP LISTGREY LINEWho is in the cast of XO, Kitty season 3?XO, Kitty Season 2Park Young-Sol/NetflixAs confirmed by Netflix, the cast of XO, Kitty season 3 includes Anna Cathcart as Kitty Song Covey, Minyeong Choi as Dae, real-life siblings Gia Kim and Sang Heon Lee as Yuri and Min Ho, Anthony Keyvan as Q, Regan Aliyah as Juliana, Hojo Shin as Jiwon, Peter Thurnwald as Alex, Joshua Lee as Jin, Sasha Bhasin as Praveena, Michael K. Lee as Professor Lee, Philippe Lee as Mr. Moon, Jocelyn Shelfo as Madison, Han Bi Ryu as Eunice, and Sunny Oh as Mihee.Related: Sang Heon Lee Wanted to Ban Sister Gia Kim From Set for This XO, Kitty SceneNew cast members Sule Thelwell, Soy Kim, and Christine Hwang have also joined the ensemble this season. Thelwell joined the cast as a season regular, playing a character named Marius, while Kim and Hwang joined the cast as recurring guest stars playing Yisoo and Gigi, respectively.Sule ThelwellSule ThelwellPhoto by Jan Dreyer, courtesy of NetflixSoy KimSoy KimPhoto courtesy of NetflixChristine HwangChristine HwangPhoto by Sam Prickart, courtesy of NetflixNot only that, but Lana Condor will also reprise her role as Lara Jean Covey for season 3 of XO, Kitty! Netflix announced the cameo on March 6, 2026, with a social video.This marks the second time one of the lead actors from the original TATB series appears in XO, Kitty. ICYMI: Noah Centineo, who rose to fame as Peter Kavinsky in the franchise, reprised his role for a special cameo in season 2.XO, KittyPark Young-Sol/Netflix↑BACK TO TOP LISTGREY LINEIs there a trailer for XO, Kitty season 3?There is no trailer for XO, Kitty season 3 yet, but we know it will be released on March 9, 2026. In the meantime, you can rewatch the trailer for season 2 below:↑BACK TO TOP LISTGREY LINEAre there any first-look photos from XO, Kitty season 3?There are indeed. Netflix released the first nine pictures from XO, Kitty season 3 on February 11, 2026. In the photos below, we see Kitty and Minho still surrounded by cherry blossoms, Jin and Q still showing chemistry, Juliana and Praveena exploring their relationship, and Yuri and Kitty getting up close and personal. It also looks like the KISS students might be taking a trip to Busan and Lotte World, and, of course, we will have a party or two.YOUNGSOL PARK/NETFLIXCOURTESY OF NETFLIXPark Young-Sol/NetflixCOURTESY OF NETFLIXCOURTESY OF NETFLIXYOUNGSOL PARK/NETFLIXCOURTESY OF NETFLIXCOURTESY OF NETFLIXCOURTESY OF NETFLIX↑BACK TO TOP LISTGREY LINEWhat is XO, Kitty season 3 going to be about?Warning: spoilers for XO, Kitty season 1 and 2 ahead!Well, XO, Kitty season 3 will be about… Kitty, duh, and of course, her love life and antics at K.I.S.S. — that's the Korean Independent School of Seoul, in case you need a refresher. Our leading lady ended season 2 in a very similar predicament to season 1, only the roles are reversed this time around.Season 1 ended with Kitty expelled and on her way to the U.S. — Portland, to be more specific — with Min Ho, played by Sang Heon Lee, tagging along in economy and confessing his feelings for her. Season 2 kicked off with Min Ho being rejected, and Kitty still hung up on Yuri. However, as Min Ho moves on with Stella, Kitty starts to realize she also has feelings for him and, after much bonding, decides to ask to join him and his family as they set off on tour during the summer — but Min Ho is “swearing off all relationships" after his traumatic experience with Stella.Park Young-Sol/NetflixFans are wondering if Kitty and Min Ho's relationship will once again take center stage for season 3, and while the showrunner didn't confirm what exactly will happen with them, she did promise “romance.”“I know we left fans on a cliffhanger at the end of Season 2, but I can promise Season 3 will be worth the wait, including our first summer episode — not to mention plenty of romance, friendship, adventure ... and kissing,” O’Toole continued. “Lots of kissing.”Was Kitty able to join him on tour, or did something happen immediately after that stopped her? Will we return to K.I.S.S. the next academic year, now that Kitty's scholarship has been extended? Too many questions!Related: The XO, Kitty Season 2 Cast Explain How the Netflix Series Navigates the Space Between Friendship & RomanceAside from Kitty and Min Ho's romance, there are also other relationships to be explored in XO, Kitty's third season. After the talent show, are Eunice and Dae still in love? Can Dae and Min Ho go back to BFF status? And also, what will happen to Stella now that her cover is blown? Can she return?Park Young-Sol/NetflixThere are also new couples on the horizon: Can Jin and Q go the distance now that Q is headed to USC for a summer training program? Is their relationship ready for a summer apart?Park Young-Sol/NetflixWe also have to keep an eye on Praveena and Juliana. Speaking to Teen Vogue, Sasha Bhasin, who plays Praveena, admitted she'd love for people to see more of the new couple if the show gets renewed.XO, Kitty Season 2Park Young-Sol/Netflix"If there's a season 3, in my ideal world, it's like Juliana and I are in this fun relationship like honeymoon space," Bhasin said. “Then you get to know Praveena a bit more, a little bit more about where she's from, how she is like this, why she is always so cute and has the cutest shoes and outfits. I just want to get to know Praveena a little bit more in relation to the other characters. She's gone to this school before. We kind of got the inkling that her parents are CIA. What is that about? I would love to see that. I would love to see her be really integrated into the friend group and really see her in relation to other characters — and see her make up with Kitty. I hope that Praveena and Kitty can be friends.”Related: XO, Kitty Season 2 Breakout Star Sasha Bhasin on Playing Praveena, Kitty's Love Triangles, and Season 3 HopesAnother big question mark that season 3 would hopefully address is Yuri's future because things are not looking up for her family — or Dae's. During the final episode, we learn that Yuri is broke as her family's company, the Han Group, is involved in a class action lawsuit, and all her father's assets are frozen — but at least she has her newfound brother Alex on her side.Courtesy of NetflixThe lawsuit might be a nightmare for Yuri, but it's a saving grace for Dae and his dad, who had a major accident this season and is still recovering, is also involved and seemingly being compensated generously. “From now on, we are going to be fine,” he told Dae after the talent showcase. Aaaaand scene. So, to sum up: Lots of potential storylines for season 3.↑BACK TO TOP LISTGREY LINEWhen did XO, Kitty season 3 get confirmed?Courtesy of NetflixNetflix confirmed on February 14, 2025, that season 3 of XO, Kitty is on its way. In the announcement, Netflix wrote that while viewers can expect Kitty Song Covey to return to the Korean Independent School of Seoul, but first, “a summer of love is on the horizon” for the main character.“I’m so excited to head back to Seoul for another season with our incredible cast and crew. If you thought junior year at KISS brought the drama, just wait,” XO, Kitty showrunner and executive producer Jessica O’Toole said in a statement.People expected its renewal since season 2 of XO, Kitty debuted at #2 on the English TV List with 72.1 million hours viewed and appeared in the Top 10 in 90 (!) countries in its first week. The sophomore season of the show is still tracking for its first-week numbers, but Netflix has confirmed that it also debuted at #2 on the English TV list with 14.2 million views in one weekend alone, so watch this space for the final stats and how they could impact its renewal status.↑BACK TO TOP LISTGREY LINEWhen did XO, Kitty season 3 finish filming?On July 17, 2025, Netflix announced that XO, Kitty season 3 had officially wrapped filming in Seoul, South Korea. The streamer announced the news, posting a recap video from the cast on set, which you can watch below.Production for XO, Kitty season 3 seems to have lasted a couple of months. Back on May 18, cast members Joshua Lee, Sasha Bhasin, and Regan Aliyah all posted updates sharing they were back in Seoul “for no reason at all!!” — a.k.a more than likely filming for the show.↑BACK TO TOP LISTGREY LINEThis story will continue to be updated as news about XO, Kitty Season 3 breaks.Originally Appeared on Teen VogueWant more Netflix stories?
